description: Finds satellites and other tracked objects by name, alias or catalogue number, in the catalogue of everything in orbit. Call it when a person names a satellite in words (Hubble, Starlink, Tiangong, a GPS satellite) to learn its catalogue number and alias. Each match says what the object is (a space station, a telescope, a rocket body, debris), which orbit it flies, whether it can be seen with the naked eye, and its page where it has one. It cannot tell where a satellite is now or when it passes over a place.

language.description: The language of the answer and of the page it links: en (the default) or es

query.description: Part of the name, the alias or the catalogue number: iss, hubble, starlink, 25544. Case and accents do not matter.

name: find_satellites
title: Find satellites
